newsitem.title: INDONESIA: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - July 15.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - July 15.

text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Indonesian press on July 15. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
At least 60 people died after a boat carrying 200 passengers sank on Monday night in lake Toba in North Sumatra province. Police said the boat was overloaded.
Indonesian economists are confident the country's economic fundamentals are strong enough to withstand speculative attacks on the rupiah.

Indonesia's Foreign Minister Ali Alatas has said the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) ministerial team set to meet Cambodian leaders does not intend to interfere in the country's internal affairs but hopes to avert rising tension which could destabilise the region.

Head of the Indonesian delegation to the Consultative Group on Indonesia (CGI), Saleh Affif, has expressed optimism over Indonesia's chance to receive the same amount of aid and loans it got last year.
